MATCH (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
WITH o, t,

       THEN 1 ELSE 0

MATCH (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
WITH o, t,
     STRPTIME(o.birth_date,

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
MATCH (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND t.team_name <> 'Golden State Warriors'
WITH o, t,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, '/')
       THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
       ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, ' ', 3) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, '/')
       THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
       ELSE CASE
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'January') THEN 1
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'February') THEN 2
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'March') THEN 3
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'April') THEN 4
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'May') THEN 5
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'June') THEN 6
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'July') THEN 7
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'August') THEN 8
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'September') THEN 9
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'October') THEN 10
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'November') THEN 11
         WHEN STARTS_WITH(o.birth_date, 'December') THEN 12
       END
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, '/')
       THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
       ELSE CAST(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(o.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', '') AS INT64)
  END AS birth_day
WITH o, t, 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age >= 67
RETURN age AS col1, t.team_name AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
